title: Medusa
summary: Writing and directing a feature-length film, developed and realised in collaboration with a larger cast and crew.
heading: A feature film.
description:
Medusa (2023) is a feature-length psychological thriller with surreal elements, set in a small town near the Thuringian Forest. When a young man arrives for a date that never takes place, his evening takes an unexpected and increasingly unsettling turn.

The film was produced by ilmpressions, a student-run film production initiative at the Technical University of Ilmenau, Germany. Developed and realized by a team of more than 50 students, the project brought together different creative and technical departments to produce an independent feature film.

Written and directed by Kim-Fabio Klein, Medusa premiered on July 15, 2023 at the Audimax of TU Ilmenau.
